title: Export data
description: Download everything the shop has stored as one zip, to keep, to check or to move elsewhere.

contents.title: What is in the file
contents.tables: Every table of the shop: products, stock movements, customers, guarantors, sales, contracts and schedules, payments, cash, expenses, suppliers, purchases, the audit log and the rest, linked by their ids.
contents.formats: Each table twice: a CSV file that opens in Excel (Arabic shows correctly, no cell can run a formula) and a JSON file.
contents.manifest: A manifest with the row count of every table and control totals (cash, stock, open installments, sales, payments), so the data can be restored and checked.
contents.files: Uploaded files such as the logo and ID photos are not inside; the files table lists them.
contents.keep: The zip is kept for 7 days, then removed. You can export once an hour.

start.title: New export
start.fullIdsHint: Without this, national IDs show only the last four digits. A full export is recorded in the audit log.
start.masked: National IDs in this export show only the last four digits.
start.running: An export is in progress. This page updates by itself.

started: The export has started. It can take a few minutes.
removed: The file was removed after 7 days

history.title: Your exports
history.empty: No export yet. Press Export all data to start one.

failure.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: The shop has more data than one export can hold. Contact support.
failure.EXPORT_PERMISSION_LOST: The person who asked for it no longer has the right to export.
failure.EXPORT_FAILED: The export could not be completed. Try again, or contact support.

errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
